question: How many Fundamental Duties were added to the Indian Constitution through the 42nd Amendment Act of 1976?
solution:
The correct answer is __**10**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **42nd Amendment Act of 1976 added 10 Fundamental Duties** to the Indian Constitution.
 
• The duties were added to promote a sense of patriotism and responsibility among citizens
 
• They are listed in Article 51A of Part IV-A of the Constitution
 
• They are non-justiciable, meaning they cannot be enforced by law. 
 
• The amendment was brought in during the emergency period and was a response to the perceived breakdown of civic sense and morality in the country.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are a set of moral obligations that are expected of every citizen of India, and they were added to the Constitution to promote national unity and a sense of responsibility among citizens.
